# MyAnimeList

> > MyAnimeList is the world's most comprehensive anime and manga database, tracking thousands of series, movies, OVAs, and specials with community ratings and reviews.

MyAnimeList.net serves as the premier destination for anime fans to discover, track, and discuss Japanese animation across all formats (TV series, movies, OVAs, ONAs, specials). The platform aggregates data from studios like Shin-Ei Animation, A-1 Pictures, Kyoto Animation, Studio 4°C, and many others, covering genres from comedy and magical girl to sci-fi and supernatural.

## Key Topics

- Anime database and search
- TV series (tv-anime, tv-series)
- OVA (Original Video Animation)
- Anime movies and films
- Comedy anime
- Magical girl genre
- Supernatural anime
- Sci-fi anime
- Studio production (Shin-Ei Animation, A-1 Pictures, Kyoto Animation, HAL Film Maker)
- Anime News Network cross-reference
- AniDB integration
- Short films and specials
- Super-power anime
- Anime community ratings

## Anime Database & Search

- [Anime - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime.php): Main anime database search and browse page with advanced filters

## Popular TV Series

- [Nichijou (Nichijou - My Ordinary Life, TV 2011) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/10165): Nichijou slice-of-life comedy by Kyoto Animation (Spring 2011)
- [Akazukin Chacha (Red Riding Hood Chacha) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/103/Akazukin_Chacha): Red Riding Hood Chacha magical girl comedy (Winter 1994 TV series)
- [Shin Shirayuki-hime Densetsu Prétear (TV 2001) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/100/Shin_Shirayuki-hime_Densetsu_Pr%C3%A9tar): Prétear: The New Legend of Snow White anime series by HAL Film Maker
- [DD Hokuto no Ken (DD Fist of the North Star) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/10177/DD_Hokuto_no_Ken): Super-deformed parody of Hokuto no Ken (Fist of the North Star)
- [Nyanpire The Animation (TV 2011) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/10197): Nyanpire vampire cat comedy by Gonzo (Summer 2011 short series)

- [Break Blade Movie 6: Doukoku no Toride (Broken Blade 6, Movie 2011) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/10092/Break_Blade_Movie_6__Doukoku_no_Toride): Sixth and final Break Blade movie by Production I.G and Xebec

- [Esper Mami Special: My Angel Mami-chan (TV Special 1988) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/10000/Esper_Mami_Special__My_Angel_Mami-chan): Esper Mami TV special episode by Shin-Ei Animation (1988)
- [Yakumotatsu (Eight Clouds Rising) - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/1026/Yakumotatsu): Eight Clouds Rising supernatural OVA by Studio Pierrot
- [Anemone - MyAnimeList.net](https://myanimelist.net/anime/10516/Anemone): Anemone short drama OVA about internal journey and self-discovery
